description: Search for places matching a text query, optionally centred on a location within a radius.

location.description: Optional centre point for the search, as an object with latitude and longitude in decimal degrees.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees of the search centre point.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees of the search centre point.

query.description: Text query to search for places, for example a place name or category; must be a non-empty string.

radius.description: Optional search radius in metres around location; must be positive and is clamped to a maximum of 50000.

name: maps_search_places
